run_schedule.weekly_production_schedule: Run one production crawl per day at 02:00 UTC; capture timestamp, country, service, tier, localized price/currency/period, source URL, HTTP/render status, and diff against prior run. Retry failed storefronts at 08:00 UTC and flag unresolved gaps.

stores: official Apple country Apple Music and Apple One pages
official YouTube Premium and Music Premium country storefront/checkout pages
localized iOS/Android app-store subscription sheets when official web page lacks displayed price

historical_backfill.lookback: 12 months where archived official pages or first-party price history is available
historical_backfill.method: store dated snapshots; never backfill from third-party aggregators; mark unavailable fields null/gap

implementation_notes: Use country/locale routing and verify the displayed currency matches the target country; do not infer local prices from USD or exchange rates.
Prefer logged-out official pages; if checkout or app-store context is required, record the exact storefront, locale, account state assumptions, and displayed text.
Extract every locally offered Spotify tier first and treat Spotify gaps as high priority; distinguish unavailable from temporarily blocked or not offered.
Capture screenshots/HTML plus normalized numeric values so price changes can be audited.
Run change detection against the 2026-09-25 baseline and preserve old rows rather than overwriting them.
For annual plans, store annual price and period separately; do not convert to monthly unless also retaining the displayed annual amount.
Rate-limit, retry transient failures, and send alerts for Spotify price/tier changes or missing countries.
